changelog: Fixes the Phone entry disappearing after a clean install on some devices, and adds more brands to the first-run dock for Phone, Messages, Camera, and Contacts. Apps can now pin shortcuts onto the desktop, such as a WeChat mini program. Shortcut icons follow the current theme.
changelogZh: 修复部分机型卸载重装后电话入口消失，并补齐更多品牌首次安装时底栏的电话、短信、相机和联系人。支持应用内把快捷方式固定到桌面，例如微信小程序「添加到桌面」；图标跟随当前主题。
